The GreenAgent (reviewer) addresses sustainability through improved error messaging and resource lifecycle control. The cluster imbalance issue (Issue #142340) directly conflicts with sustainability goals—aggressive rebalancing for efficiency may increase energy consumption, while conservative approaches preserve resources but impact latency. The multi-value field optimization problem in EFF-L2-002-01/02/03 lacks clarity on whether proposed solutions minimize or increase resource footprint. The ES|QL error messaging improvements (SUS-L2-003-02/03) represent convergence opportunity: clearer error messages reduce user query iterations, lowering overall system load and energy consumption.

The ResponsibilityAgent addresses Requirement 1 (Issue #142340: DiskBBQ cluster imbalance) with six coherent responsibility-focused requirements spanning regulatory accountability, stakeholder transparency, and ethical compliance. The cluster imbalance issue relates to infrastructure-level balancing and latency consistency, while the query planner optimization relates to aggregate function correctness and multivaluedness handling.
